title: ReLU Playground: Evidence Becomes Geometry
tagline: Four XOR points and four filled XOR regions ask different questions. See the evidence, every ReLU hinge, and the resulting boundary.
summary: A from-scratch, deterministic 2-D classification playground built around simple ReLU networks. Contrast the four-point XOR truth table with a filled-quadrant XOR field, inspect every hidden-unit activation map, load exact teaching constructions, and train on blobs, circles, moons, or spirals with adjustable width, depth, learning rate, and seed.
highlights: Separate four-point XOR from filled-quadrant XOR and compare training accuracy with agreement over the whole field.
Load an exact two-ReLU corner construction or an exact four-ReLU regional construction before training anything.
Inspect a live activation map and equation for every hidden unit, including either layer of a two-layer network.
Train, pause, step once, reset, and change a deterministic seed while watching the probability surface and loss update.
Switch among XOR, blobs, concentric circles, moons, and spirals using the same inspectable from-scratch gradient code.
